text: Planning a trip is exciting, but it also takes time and effort. You need to choose a destination, book tickets, and pack your bags. When you travel, you meet new cultures and try delicious food you have never tasted before. Sometimes you face language barriers, which can be difficult, but you can use gestures or simple words to communicate. These moments often become funny stories later. Every journey gives you special memories that stay with you forever. That is why travelling is one of the best ways to learn about the world and yourself.
